BiblicalUsage: Hezro is one of David's mighty men, named in both lists of the thirty. He is called Hezro the Carmelite, and he stands among the warriors who fought at David's side through the long war with the house of Saul.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that men like Hezro are remembered because they stood faithful in the hard years, and God keeps the names of the faithful.
